name: Griffith counselling and wellbeing services
summary: Free, confidential counselling for enrolled Griffith students, plus a 24/7 mental wellbeing support line.
key: Free and confidential counselling, plus the 24/7 Mental Wellbeing Support Line on 1300 785 442.
who: Currently enrolled Griffith students (or holding an offer, on approved leave or deferment).
Recent graduates within three months (six months for previous clients).
how: Book telehealth online, or call (07) 3735 7299 (Nathan) or (07) 5552 8734 (Gold Coast) for limited face-to-face appointments.
catches: Not available to students outside Australia.

evidence.quote: High-quality, free and confidential counselling and wellbeing services
